instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Dice the onion and cook it with 1/4 tsp of the salt for 4 to 5 minutes, until soft. Mince the garlic, add it and cook for 1 minute.
Dice the tomatoes. Add them to the pot and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until they break down and the pot looks saucy.
Meanwhile, trim the zucchini and dice it into 1/2-inch pieces.

Add the broth, zucchini, corn, 3 cilantro sprigs, the oregano and the remaining 1/2 tsp salt. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook over medium-low heat for 10 minutes, until the zucchini is just tender.
Turn off the heat. Stir in the milk and remove the cilantro sprigs.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
Grate the cheese. Fill each bowl halfway with soup, add a handful of tortilla chips and some cheese, then top with more soup so the cheese melts.
method_notes: Lead is Ali Cooks' calabacitas, corn and tomato soup (5 from 2 ratings, so a fallback lead). Mexican Please has more ratings (3.8 from 29) but sits under the 4.0 floor; it builds a blended roasted tomato broth and keeps the zucchini in small dice, which matches here. Both finish quickly so the zucchini stays slightly firm. The lead stirs in unsweetened plant milk; whole milk is used instead so the soup is nut-free.
